title: spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Example calculation has incorrect modulo result
description:
The example states '926423932 MOD 7 = 1' but 926423932 is exactly divisible by 7 (926423932 = 7 * 132346276), so the remainder is 0, not 1. This means the calculated channel should be 1 + 0 = 1, not 2. Either the hash value, the channel result, or both are incorrect in this example.

Fix suggestion: Verify the actual FNV-1a32 hash of the input data and correct either the hash value or the channel result to match the true calculation.
close_reason: Already fixed: spec/appendix-ccp12-hopping.md line 121 now correctly shows 926423932 MOD 7 = 0 (not 1), yielding channel 1 (not 2). Test vectors in ccp16.json also confirm channel 1. The modulo calculation and resulting channel are now mathematically correct.
